roles.responsible_for: 护照登记、E0-E4 门判定申报、退役与恢复决定
roles.must_not_impersonate: 法定规划审批、行业监管与许可机关
roles.fallback_if_absent: 服务不得进入测试；P1 申报退回补充材料

roles.responsible_for: 长期运营、运营期限与续办条件、日常记录公开
roles.fallback_if_absent: 不得发布；仅可停留在沙盒状态

roles.responsible_for: 现场安全审查、实体急停、五类回滚触发器的停机判定
roles.fallback_if_absent: 不进入受控试点；试点期间缺岗立即停摆并亮平线灯

roles.responsible_for: 数据上限与留存期核验、未声明数据禁止采集、退役后数据删除确认
roles.fallback_if_absent: 未声明数据不得采集；数据越界即触发隐私类回滚

roles.responsible_for: 无 AI 等价基线核验、三道异议门主持、与安全角色可独立叫停试验
roles.must_not_impersonate: 影响人群的专业责任与法律责任
roles.fallback_if_absent: 不得宣称 AI 带来改善；异议门缺失不得发布

roles.responsible_for: E3 独立复测、blackout_drill 与 bequest_audit 审计、失败记录匿名化公开
roles.must_not_impersonate: 任何运营主体不得自证其退场审计（no operator certifies its own bequest audit）
roles.fallback_if_absent: 复测缺失不得扩大范围；bequest_audit 不可跳过

roles.responsible_for: 退役时恢复场地与公共空间基线、平线档案墙陈列材料
roles.fallback_if_absent: 场地恢复未确认，退役程序不关闭

roles.responsible_for: 异议、申诉与叫停请求通道；听证参与
roles.must_not_impersonate: 不承担专业责任，不负担义务性审查
roles.fallback_if_absent: 申诉通道缺失，服务不得向公众开放

constitutional_rules: Every public-AI service has exactly one accountable lead; interface roles never impersonate statutory authorities.
The public-baseline steward and the safety role may stop a trial independently.
No operator may certify its own bequest audit.
The affected public has review and appeal routes but is never burdened with professional liability.
Roles are proposal concepts, not current authorities; they do not replace planning approval, sector regulation or statutory evaluation.
